privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.intro: Your privacy is important to us. By using Track by Track, some personal data is collected in accordance with current legislation, mainly to ensure the best possible experience on the platform.
privacyPolicy.dataUsage: When you create your account, we collect information such as your name and email. This data is used exclusively for authentication, personalizing your experience, and app features such as displaying your profile, calculating rating averages, and showing your history.
privacyPolicy.dataSharing: Your data is not shared with third parties, except when required by law. We do not use your data for marketing purposes.
privacyPolicy.support: You can request deletion of your data at any time through the app or by contacting our support. For more information, email contatotrackbytrack@gmail.com.

termsOfUse.title: Terms of Use
termsOfUse.agreement: By using this platform, you agree to respect the established rules and policies, including the responsible use of features and providing truthful information during registration. Track by Track uses the official Spotify API only to display public information about albums, artists, and tracks. We do not store, redistribute, or make available any protected content from Spotify.
termsOfUse.prohibited: It is not permitted to use the platform for illegal or offensive purposes, to circumvent Spotify restrictions, to access third-party data without consent, or to violate Spotify's Terms of Service.
termsOfUse.breach: Failure to comply with the terms may result in account suspension or deletion, as well as possible legal sanctions.
termsOfUse.updates: These terms may be updated periodically. We recommend that you review them regularly.

about.title: About
about.description: Track by Track is a platform for music lovers who want to rate albums track by track, creating a detailed record of their musical experiences.
about.purpose: Our purpose is to offer an organized way to document your impressions of albums, allowing you to compare your ratings with other users and rediscover music that has marked your life.
about.spotifyDescription: We use the official Spotify API to fetch accurate information about albums, artists, and tracks. Our application does not store or distribute copyright-protected content from Spotify.
about.disclaimer: This application is not affiliated, associated, authorized, endorsed by, or in any way officially connected with Spotify AB. The Spotify name, as well as related brands, logos, and images are registered trademarks of their respective owners.
